transcript: I'm not all that imaginative. So the options given were plentiful. I can't really see anything that's missing. I think for any of it to work, people need to kind of buy in. And I think that's where the legal system comes into play in which people kind of buy in. We kind of see that as of now, only a few individuals commit the crimes, but a large majority abide by it. So there's nothing in particular that I see that I would particularly change on my own.
